knimeNode.name: Selection
knimeNode.shortDescription: Selects mating parents or prepares Differential Evolution donors.

fullDescription.intro: Automatically reads objectives, directions, constraints, variables, and bounds from Problem Setup. Tournament and random modes select ordinary mating parents. Differential Evolution mode keeps one target row per individual and attaches hidden donor information for the Mutation and Crossover nodes.

ports.inPort: Optional SHADE/L-SHADE archive; ignored by ordinary selection.
ports.outPort: Mating parents or DE target/donor bundles.
